title: Hummingbird ChatPlay
text:
Hummingbird ChatPlay

notes:
Inbound via Discord bot demo submitted 2026-03-01. Founder: Maya Lin (cto). Small indie social MMO for iOS/Android. Wants to replace rule-based filter with model-based moderation and allow LLM system messages for NPC chat. Emphasis: <100ms p95 in chat paths, high throughput during weekend events. Quote: "We need something that won't explode our cloud bill when events hit." Interested in hosted API self-serve trial first. Wants to try streaming for typing feel. SE call 2026-03-09: ran quick demo with sample prompt; saw latency at ~220ms p95 on competitor. Asked about prefix caching and token cost controls. Security: no PII in chat, but wants audit logs + short retention (30d). Proposed POC: 2-week sandbox using hosted API with 5k monthly tokens, synthetic load run during off hours. Action items: send benchmark deck, sample streaming code, trial key + quickstart steps. Follow-up: schedule onboarding call week of 2026-03-16.

next_step:
Send latency benchmark deck + invite to POC signup; share trial API key usage limits

blockers:
need production latency SLA numbers
clarify pricing for burst traffic
moderation false-positive tolerance thresholds
